lines.zh: 我背着货走在这条路上。
lines.en: I walk this road with goods on my back.
I'm not fast; the load isn't light.
I follow the river where the going's flat.

lines.zh: 我在村外的石头上歇脚。
lines.en: I rest on a stone outside the village.
I pass along the wood's edge.
I read the signs as I walk.
Bottles clink in my bag.
I walk in the cart ruts.
I pause and check the sky.

lines.zh: 我离开这条路，往小径去。
lines.en: I leave the road for a footpath.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地走进下一个镇子。
lines.en: I walk slowly into the next town.
I take the old road as always.
I sit at the roadside to rest.
I lay my goods out one by one.
I'm waiting for someone to ask a price.
There's hardly anyone on the road.
I straighten my cloak.
I look at my own boots.

lines.zh: 我在数还剩几天到集上。
lines.en: I'm counting the days to the market.

lines.zh: 风吹得路边的草一直动。
lines.en: The roadside grass keeps moving in the wind.
I polish a gem.
I've worn through three pairs of soles.
I hum a line or two; no one hears.
I tie the bag shut.
Would you like to see my wares?
You smell of minerals.
I've a bit of everything here.
Easy now; the price is negotiable.
You're on this road too.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，走了很远。
lines.en: I know those boots; you've come far.

lines.zh: 你要是有绿宝石，我们就谈。
lines.en: If you've emeralds, we can talk.
I won't ask where you're going.
This road isn't safe; be careful.
I pull my cloak a little lower.
You don't look like you're from here.
We can just go our separate ways.
If you've goods to sell, I buy too.
Have you heard of other towns.
I clutch my arm and back off.
My bag hits the ground.
I bend over, breathing hard.
That one landed square.
I slowly pick the bag up.
Blood runs down my fingers onto the goods.
I brace against a tree.
I back off a long way before stopping.
The road's bad today.
I press my ribs and shuffle two steps.
I'll take that at a fair price.
That one's worth something.
I turn it over to check the grain on the back.
That won't trade; it's too light.
I'll give three emeralds.
Don't agree yet; look around first.
I've a fine blade here.
I'm not keen on that one.
Add a little and we have a deal.
Done; it's yours.
You've knocked into my bag.
I grab the strap quickly.
A bottle nearly breaks.

lines.zh: 我一把抱住晃动的货袋。
lines.en: I grab my swinging pack and hold it.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的斗篷掀开了。
lines.en: The bump flips my cloak open.

lines.zh: 我把东西一件件捡起来。
lines.en: I pick my goods up one by one.
You're in even more of a hurry than I am.
We only need to give each other room.
I smile; I'm not angry.
Do watch yourself on the road.
She carries goods too.
We traded a few things.
She hands me a gem.
We sit and count our own stock.
She says the eastern towns are rich.
Tomorrow we go different ways.
Her cloak has been mended many times.
We nod to each other.
Meeting on the road is its own luck.
She's gone; I go back to my wares.
I hold it to the light.

lines.zh: 我把它对着天光照了照。
lines.en: I hold it up against the sky.

lines.zh: 我把它放进专门的格子。
lines.en: I put it in its own compartment.
I wrap it in two cloths.
It's heavy; I weigh it.
I note who gave it to me.
This one I'll resell.

lines.zh: 我把它和别的货放一起。
lines.en: I put it in with the rest.
There's a chip in it.
I can trade this for two handfuls of wheat.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看见了。
lines.en: I've seen what's in your hand.
Let's talk; no need for that.

lines.zh: 我把背带往肩上提了提。
lines.en: I hitch the straps higher on my shoulder.
Put the blade down and we'll talk.
I'm only a pedlar.

lines.zh: 这条路上动手，对谁都不好。
lines.en: A fight on this road serves no one.
I raise my hands, empty.
I might have what you want.
I stop my work and watch you.
There are others nearby.
I step to the roadside and clear the way.
You'd better not push me.

lines.zh: 你的手往腰后摸了一下。
lines.en: Your hand slips behind your waist.
You're one step from my goods.
I slip the strap off, ready to run.
There's a stone at the roadside; I've noted it.
I edge toward the trees.
You needn't keep following.

lines.zh: 我把一样东西放在地上。
lines.en: I set something down on the ground.
Take that as my peace offering.
Take it and I'll go.
I'm backing away, step by step.
There's a fork in the path ahead.
I know this footpath.
Stop following me, please.
I take it on my bag.
I swing my staff.

lines.zh: 这一下只打在你胳膊上。
lines.en: It lands on your arm only.
I back two paces, shielding the bag.
I throw a fistful of dirt.

lines.zh: 你被迷了眼，我转身就跑。
lines.en: You blink, and I turn to run.
I shoulder into you once.
My staff snaps in my hands.
I block; my grip goes numb.
I flee with my pack hugged to my chest.
I block your blade with my bag.
I fling a handful of goods at you.
I come from the far end of the road.

lines.zh: 我的货袋压得我肩膀低。
lines.en: My bag pulls one shoulder down.
I settle my cloak.
I follow an old map to find the road.
I work out which way the wind comes from.

lines.zh: 我把斗篷的帽子拉起来。
lines.en: I pull up my cloak's hood.
There are fresh prints on the road.
I hitch the bag up.
I hear someone ahead.
I set my pack down against a tree.

lines.zh: 我放慢脚步，先摸摸货袋。
lines.en: I slow down and first check my pack.

lines.zh: 这条路通向下一个镇子。
lines.en: This road leads to the next town.
I set a few wares out.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的斗篷，我打滚扑灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak; I roll to put it out.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，袋子散了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my bag spills.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我抓着岸边的草。
lines.en: Water floods in; I grip the bank weeds.
The blast throws me into the ditch.

lines.zh: 一根箭扎穿了我的货袋。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my bag.

lines.zh: 那道光让我手里的东西掉了。
lines.en: The light makes me drop what I hold.

lines.zh: 好几天没吃东西，走不动了。
lines.en: Days without food and I can't walk.
Lightning hits the roadside and I drop flat.

lines.zh: 脚下没有路，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There's no road under me and I keep falling.
